## the standalone variant — a whole app in one file

`@viva/variant/standalone` is the shortest complete thing Vivalence can be: one file that declares an entity, a domain, a mode with a face, an LLM coach, and the machine that boots them. It is the tech demo — every claim on this page, running.

### 1 · one file is the whole recipe

A variant is normally a *recipe* — a list of registry modules to assemble. This one declares its modules inline, so there is nothing else to read.

```js title="registry/viva/variant/standalone/standalone.viva.js"
export const manifest = { type: "variant", slug: "standalone", version: "0.0.1" };
```

### 2 · an entity, declared beside its schema

The dataspace grows a new persisted type with no migration to author — the class and its MikroORM schema sit together, and the daemon collates them at boot.

```js title="standalone.viva.js — retention"
class RetentionEntity extends DataEntity {
  literal;
  streak = 0;
  seen = 0;
  lastSignal = "";
}
```

### 3 · one Vector, mounted twice

The load/review pair is declared once. It becomes the coach's **tools** and the app's **call surface** — same declaration, two folds. This is the dispatch spine, made concrete.

```js title="standalone.viva.js — flashcard" {2,3}
const flashcard = {
  tools: deck,
  aperture: deck,
};
```

### 4 · the mode carries its face

Six traits and a Svelte view written inline with the `svelte` tag. `APPLICATION` gives it a face, `HARNESSED` gives it cognition, `DATASET` seeds its two italian cards.

```js title="standalone.viva.js — manifest"
traits: ["APPLICATION", "STANDALONE", "DATASET", "TOOLED", "HARNESSED", "EXPOSED"],
```

### 5 · the machine

A runtime, one daemon whose kernel is `[domain, flashcard]`, a lighthouse service, and the kajuit client — the same four nouns every deployment has.

```js title="standalone.viva.js — daemons"
kernel: [domain, flashcard],
```

### run it

```sh
deno task ghost/run /variant/clone @viva/variant/standalone ./testament/standalone
cd testament/standalone && cp .env.example .env && $EDITOR .env
deno task runtime/run
deno task kajuit/run
```

:::note
The flashcard coach is `HARNESSED`, so it wants `SECRET_VIVA_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`. The deck, the review loop, and the Retention entity all work without one.
:::
